name: Careers for Youth and Young Adults (Workforce Colorado Jefferson, Clear Creek, Gilpin)
org: Workforce Colorado Jefferson, Clear Creek, Gilpin
city: Golden, CO (Jefferson, Clear Creek and Gilpin counties)
what_you_do: Job search help and career coaching. You get links to paid and unpaid work experience and hiring events for young adults. The office also helps with the Governor's Summer Job Hunt.
who_can_apply: Youth and young adults ages 14 to 24.
pay_detail: Services are free. The page says it connects people to paid and unpaid work experience.
deadline_text: No deadline. Call or book a Career Coach appointment.
how_to_apply: Call 303-271-4755 or schedule an appointment with a Career Coach on the page.
notes: The page says the Governor's Summer Job Hunt is a free program for ages 14 to 24. Job Corps (ages 16 to 24) is also listed: 303-623-0420. Office: 3500 Illinois St, Suite 1600, Golden, CO.
